title: L¹ norm on a ball by duality with C¹ test functions
statement: Let N ∈ ℕ, R, M ∈ ℝ, and let w : ℝ^N → ℝ be integrable (Lebesgue measure L^N) on the open ball B_R(0). Suppose ∫_{ℝ^N} w ψ dL^N ≤ M for every C¹ function ψ : ℝ^N → ℝ that has compact support, satisfies tsupport ψ ⊆ B_R(0), and has |ψ(y)| ≤ 1 for all y. Then ∫_{B_R(0)} |w| dL^N ≤ M.
lean_statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) (w : Rn N → ℝ) (R M : ℝ), IntegrableOn w (Metric.ball (0 : Rn N) R) volume → (∀ ψ : Rn N → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ 1 ψ → HasCompactSupport ψ → tsupport ψ ⊆ Metric.ball (0 : Rn N) R → (∀ y, |ψ y| ≤ 1) → ∫ y, w y * ψ y ≤ M) → ∫ y in Metric.ball (0 : Rn N) R, |w y| ≤ M
